Watch time is the #1 signal. If viewers watch to the end, the video gets pushed to more people.
Comments are weighted 3-5x more than likes in the algorithm. Content that drives debate wins.
TikTok tests every video with ~200-500 people first. If engagement is high in this test group, it goes to 1K, then 10K, then 100K+.
Posting 3x/day is optimal for growth. More than 5x dilutes engagement per post.
The first 1-2 seconds determine 90% of a video's performance. Hook immediately or lose.
Replying to comments within 1 hour gives an algorithmic boost to the video.
Videos with text overlays get 30-40% more watch time than videos without.
Trending sounds give a 10-20% distribution boost. Original sounds build brand recognition.
TikTok pushes LIVE streams to followers' feeds — lives get massive organic reach.
Series content (Part 1, Part 2...) drives follows because people want the next installment.
Vertical 9:16 format is mandatory. Horizontal video gets 40% less distribution.
Best posting times vary by niche but generally: 7-9am, 12-2pm, 7-11pm local time.
New accounts are in a 'testing phase' for the first 100 videos. Consistency matters more than virality.
Stitch and Duet videos get algorithmic boost because TikTok wants to promote its social features.
